mapper.insert: INSERT INTO net_site_billing_rule ( rule_code, rule_name, unit_price, min_bill_duration, max_bill_duration, max_price, address_id, channel_no, is_active ) VALUES ( #{ruleCode}, #{ruleName}, #{unitPrice}, #{minBillDuration}, #{maxBillDuration}, #{maxPrice}, #{addressId}, #{channelNo}, #{isActive} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rule_name = VALUES(rule_name), unit_price = VALUES(unit_price), min_bill_duration = VALUES(min_bill_duration), max_bill_duration = VALUES(max_bill_duration), max_price = VALUES(max_price), address_id = VALUES(address_id), channel_no = VALUES(channel_no), is_active = VALUES(is_active), update_time = NOW()
